text:
Our review of “4 column” found 2 likely causes of the problems in Frontify and 1 possible contributing factor. The recommended changes are below.

Likely causes

1. Text frame has columns
Frontify doesn’t support multiple columns inside one text frame.
Where: text frames “dsfasdfdfs”, “dsaadsdfgdf” (page 1) and 2 more
• Set Columns to 1 in Object > Text Frame Options. Use separate text frames if you need columns.
Learn more

2. Text without a paragraph style
Frontify uses paragraph styles to format text and decide what can be edited.
Where: text frames “dsfasdfdfs”, “dsaadsdfgdf” (page 1)
• Select the text (or the whole frame) and apply a paragraph style in Window > Styles > Paragraph Styles (any style except [Basic Paragraph] or [No Paragraph Style]).
Learn more

Possible contributing factors

3. Paragraph Composer used
The Adobe Paragraph Composer breaks lines differently from browsers, so text may reflow in Frontify.
Where: the paragraph style “[Basic Paragraph]”, used on page 1
• In the paragraph style, go to Justification and set Composer to Adobe Single-line Composer.
Learn more

Worth a quick check (often fine as is)

4. Empty text frame
Empty frames are allowed, but are often left over by accident.
Where: 3 text frames on page 1
• Delete the frame if it isn’t needed.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
